observation.command: cd /tmp && mkdir -p x && dpkg-deb -x postgresql-17-pgrouting_4.0.1-1.pgdg+1_amd64.deb x && find x -name "*.so" && so=$(find x -name "*.so" | head -1); echo "SO=$so"; objdump -T "$so" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "GLIBCXX_[0-9.]+" | sort -uV | tail -5; echo "--- needed GLIBC ---"; objdump -T "$so" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "GLIBC_[0-9.]+" | sort -uV | tail -3
